chapters.title: Chapter 101. The Author Is Typing Shit at This Point. (I Agree With Myself.)
paragraphs: The seven maids made a circle around Rex and the three prisoners. They started chanting in unison, and their voices blended together in a language that Rex’s system recognized as Demonic Formal, a formalized version of the demon tongue used for complicated magic.
’I thought they spoke gibberish, but it’s a demon language indeed...’

Energy gathered around them, and it was much more stable and controlled than when Lilith teleported by herself. This was collaborative casting on a level that needed a lot of practice and skill to do well.
The world twisted, compressed, and spiraled inward.
ZWIIINNGGGG~!
When reality came back, everything was different.
They were not in a clearing in the woods anymore. They were in what looked like a huge underground room.
The light seemed to come from everywhere and nowhere, and the room was so big that Rex couldn’t see the walls or ceiling.
"Whoa... what the fuck is this place...?" Rex starts looking around.
The architecture was strange and beautiful, with flowing curves and angles that looked like they had been carved by will rather than tools.
Dark stone pillars rose up at random times, and they were covered in glowing runes that pulsed in a steady rhythm. The floor was smooth obsidian that looked like a mirror.
And Rex could see movement beyond the area right around him. Rex observed numerous instances of unusual movement.
There were demons, but there were also other things he couldn’t put a name to right away. These entities were characterized by an abundance of arms or eyes.
There were objects that appeared to fade in and out of sight. These objects were challenging to describe, as their intricate geometries eluded his understanding.
"This is... some kind of a place for weirdos," Rex thought to himself. "Nah... this place is probably full of different races that are associated with demons."
"All of them looked unique, and even the women..." Rex felt both confused and shocked when he saw a woman with five breasts. "Five boobs...!? This fantasy world is weird..."
"The author is typing shit at this point..."
"Welcome to the Underlayer," Lilith said as she walked up to him.
She sounded proud, like she was showing off her home to a guest. "The deepest level of space that a living being can live in is below the surface of this wonderful planet~!"
"Right now... we’re about 300 miles below the surface, and we are so close to the planet’s core!

While Rex thought about what he had just learned, he kept looking around. Three hundred miles below the surface would put them well past the crust and into the upper mantle by any reasonable geological standards, but clearly this world worked on different rules.
"How is there air down here?" He asked, "How can any of this happen?"
"A lot of complicated magic," Sera said, as if that made everything clear.
It probably did, to be fair.

"The Underlayer is a pocket dimension that is connected to the real world but not completely limited by its laws... The demon lords set up their domains there thousands of years ago after the great wars drove them from the surface."
She waved her arms around to show the group what was in their surroundings. "This is one of seven major population centers in the Underlayer."
"This city, called Erebus’s Rest, has about two hundred thousand demons and other exotic creatures living in it."
"Well... let’s just say it’s a paradise for monsters that’s out there for managing to live in this wonderful world!" Lilith said, with both hands raised.
Rex’s view grew, and he could see more. He could now see structures in the distance that looked like they were organized for living.

Buildings cut from stone, streets arranged in ways that made sense when you thought about how the space was three-dimensional, and places that looked like markets or meeting places where people gathered.
"Interesting... there’s a lot more to learn from this world, huh." Rex held his chin while thinking.
"There are other races down here besides demons," Mika said, pointing to a group of creatures that were walking by.
"The Shadeveil, who are born from a lot of darkness."
"The Voidkin, who live partly outside of normal reality."
"The Fleshweavers, who can change their own bodies at will. There are also many other small races that do not have official names."
"The Underlayer is run by a council of demon lords," Clara went on to say. "Each lord is in charge of a certain area and keeps things in order there."
"Lord Mordecai is in charge of the northern part of this area, which includes Erebus’s Rest and three smaller settlements."
Yuna, who had been quiet until now, spoke up in a low voice. "It’s not like the surface, where demons are hunted and killed on sight."
"Down here, we have civilization, culture, art, music, philosophy, and all the things that the surface world says we can’t do."
Rex took all of this in and put it away for later. "There’s a lot of important and unimportant shit going on all here... but for now I’ll ignore that until I face that motherfucker Mordecai.

A whole hidden civilization under the surface of the world significantly affected his long-term plans. Also, the fact that it was so organized meant that the demon threat was much more complicated than just monsters attacking human settlements.
"How do demons act on the surface?" He asked, "What do they have in common?"
"Well... it’s hard," Sera said. "Most demons never come up to the surface."
"They like living down here where it’s safe, but the demon lords have networks of spies and sometimes raid the surface world to get resources and remind humans that we still exist."

"Lord Mordecai is busier than most." Lilith added, "He thinks that demons should eventually take back the surface, not necessarily through war but by making friends and showing that we’re not the monsters that humans who live on the surface think we are."
"Is that why he was giving out the Demon Seed?" Rex asked, wanting to know how they would explain that.
Nyx laughed in a bitter way. "The Demon Seed was a mistake."
"Lord Mordecai thought that if he could create agents who lived on the surface and had demon strength but kept their human minds, it would bring our demons together."
"But the transformation process is more corruptive than he thought. Most subjects lose themselves to demon nature and become exactly the kind of monsters he was trying to prove we aren’t."
Sera said, "He’s been working on the formula, but so far, the results have been at best inconsistent and at worst... terrible."
"What the fuck...? That’s it...? The only twist that I’ve been looking for?" Rex thought to himself. "It seems like this demon lord really is a fraud if he’s a reincarnator."

They had been talking and walking along a path that went through the city streets. Rex said that other demons and creatures avoided them, either because they knew the maids were Mordecai’s servants or sensed something about Rex that made them wary.

The buildings around them were captivating because they were so different from what they were used to. They were surrounded by structures that spiraled up in ways that should have been impossible for them to accomplish.

The streets appeared as though they were curved in dimensions beyond three. Public spaces, shaped by impossible physics, evoked a combination of beauty and terror for those accustomed to conventional geometry.
And then, above everything else, there was a building that could only be Mordecai’s palace.

It was huge, at least as big as a big castle, but it was built in a way that had nothing to do with surface architecture. The black stone made flowing organic shapes, making it look like the building had grown instead of being built.
Towers twisted off at weird angles and were connected by bridges that seemed to defy gravity. The windows glowed with light from inside that changed colors in ways Rex couldn’t quite figure out.
"There it is~" Lilith said. "That’s home," and there was real love in her voice.
"Castle Nocturna is where Lord Mordecai’s power is based and where we all work."

chapters.title: Chapter 102. I Expected a Terrifying Villain, but I Got a Cosplayer (Fraud Alert)
paragraphs: They walked up to the main entrance, which was protected by two huge demons that were at least fifteen feet tall and looked like walking fortresses. The guards nodded politely to the maids and let them in without a fight, but Rex could tell that they were watching him closely.
’All of them seem like they can feel my powerful presence with this form, but... it already confirms that I can live two different lives right now.’ Rex smirks.
The inside of the palace was even more impressive. Huge rooms with ceilings that looked like they went on forever.

The walls displayed artwork depicting battles, ceremonies, and events from demon history. Servants moved quickly through the house, doing their jobs with the kind of practiced coordination that showed it was a well-run home.
They climbed a grand staircase that twisted up through several levels, going past rooms set aside for different uses. There were training halls where demons honed their fighting skills.
Libraries are full of books bound in materials that Rex didn’t know. The dining halls were furnished with long tables. Staff and important guests found places to sleep.
At the end of their journey, they encountered a set of doors clearly designed to evoke fear. They were twice as tall as Rex and made of dark metal with intricate carvings.
They gave off an aura of power that suggested strong magical protections.
Sera moved forward and put her hand on the door. "Lord Mordecai, your servants have come back."
"We have a guest who claims to have important information and prisoners that demonstrate his ability to work alongside us."
There was a pause, and then a voice came from inside. It was a boy, surprisingly young-sounding, with a hint of curiosity.
"Come in."
Rex was caught off guard hearing that voice. ’This voice... there’s no fucking way that he’s even more of a fraud than I expected.’
’Are these reincarnators who got a second chance of living really just wasting their lives to act more like a loser...? What the fuck...’
The doors opened without a sound, showing the throne room beyond.
It was big, but not in a showy way. It was made to work, not just to scare people.
There were different demon sigils on the banners that lined the walls. The floor was made of polished stone that reflected the light from magical lights.
The throne itself was at the far end of the room, up on a dais.
Mordecai Vrael, the demon lord who had planned the attack on Aethelgard, was sitting on that throne like someone who was trying to act all tough.
Just by seeing it close with his eyes, Rex felt disappointed right away, and he already has a plan to just attack the fraud right away while calling it a day.
’What a major fucking disappointment... he looks like a quiet kid who’s trying to act all tough.’
Rex thought of him as an isekai character who possesses all the privileges, while his enemies are merely frauds.
Based on the title and reputation, he thought it would be something truly horrible, like a huge figure surrounded by flames and shadows, exuding both evil and power.
Something that would explain why people were so scared of him on the surface.

Instead, he saw a young-looking boy, probably in his early twenties, dressed like a demon lord in a way that could only be described as cosplay, which is a practice where people dress up in costumes to represent a specific character from movies, games, or books.
He wore black robes with red accents, a cape that seemed too dramatic, and a horned headpiece that looked like it could have come from a fantasy convention instead of being earned through conquest.
And the worst part was that he was short. He wasn’t particularly tall, but he certainly didn’t have the intimidating stature Rex had anticipated.
He was probably only five foot six, which made the huge throne he was sitting on look funny.
[MORDECAI VRAEL DETECTED]
[CLASSIFICATION: DEMON LORD - REINCARNATOR]
[POWER LEVEL: VERY HIGH]
[NOTE: APPEARANCE DECEPTIVE - POSSESSES SIGNIFICANT COMBAT CAPABILITY AND EXTENSIVE SUBORDINATE NETWORK]
’So he really was a reincarnator who had been blessed by one of the forbidden goddesses... Chaos sounded badass, even though the presentation was a fucking joke."
"But... he was really powerful, and for now I could put that aside and keep going with my evaluation for future plans."

There were maybe a dozen other demons around the throne room, and they were clearly Mordecai’s closest allies. Most of them were built and equipped for combat, but a few looked more like advisors or administrators.
A person standing right next to Mordecai caught Rex’s eye more than the demon lord himself.

She was a woman, tall and intimidating, with red skin and black hair that fell in waves past her shoulders. Her eyes were glowing with real fire, and the armor she wore was both useful and meant to make her look even more scary and sexy.
She gave off a powerful aura that made it clear right away that she was dangerous.
[CASSANDRA VEXMOOR DETECTED]
[CLASSIFICATION: DEMON QUEEN - NATIVE]
[ROLE: MORDECAI’S GENERAL AND RIGHT HAND]
[POWER LEVEL: EXTREME]
[THREAT ASSESSMENT: LETHAL IF ENGAGED]
’Phew... now that looks like a real threat other than that one fraud-looking ass.’
Sera said, "My lord," and bowed her head.
"We present prisoners we took during our retreat, along with the person who took them.
Mordecai’s eyes were fixed on Rex, and there was real intelligence in that look. He leaned forward a little and looked at the masked figure in front of him with clear interest.
Mordecai said, "So you’re the mysterious savior that Lilith has been talking about for the past twenty minutes through our telepathic link."
His voice was relaxed but not careless. "She seems very smitten, and... she says you killed an Apostle of Justice without breaking stride and then caught three more reincarnators to show as proof."
"That’s right," Rex said.
"Where’s the proof of it?" Cassandra said sharply, her voice harsh and suspicious. "Anyone can make claims, so show us those prisoners right now."
The three bound reincarnators were pushed forward, still gagged and clearly scared. Mordecai’s eyes got a little bigger when he realized what they were.
"T-t-three living reincarnators," he said softly. "That’s really impressive...!"
"Most people who meet reincarnators either die or kill them right away." Mordecai looks invested now. "Keeping them alive shows both great power and smart thinking."
Then his face got suspicious. "But you are wearing a mask, emerged seemingly from nowhere, and coincidentally appeared immediately after my attempt was thwarted..."

"For all I know, you’re an infiltrator sent by one of the surface apostles to get close to me, right?" Mordecai pointed at him. "Give me one good reason why I shouldn’t have Cassandra kill you right now and figure out who you are later."
Cassandra moved before Rex could say anything.
She was incredibly quick, crossing the space between the throne and Rex in less than a heartbeat. Her fist shot up and hit his mask, which was surrounded by flames that could probably melt steel.
But Rex’s Foresight had shown him this very thing.
His telekinesis reached out and stopped Cassandra’s fist just one inch from his mask. The flames went around the invisible wall without hurting it, and Cassandra’s eyes went wide with shock.
"Well, genius, it’s because," Rex said calmly, his voice full of confidence, "I’m a lot stronger than anyone else in this room, even you, Cassandra Vexmoor..."
"And I have an offer that your lord is going to want to hear."

The throne room was completely quiet. Every demon in the room was staring at the scene of Cassandra, the feared Demon Queen, who was stopped in her tracks by an unseen force that she couldn’t break through no matter how hard she tried.
And what’s even more surprising is his claims, and he knew the Demon Queen’s real name.
Mordecai leaned forward on his throne, and for the first time, his face showed more than just casual interest.
It was a sign of respect.
"Very well," he said. "You may talk to me."
"You have my full attention."

chapters.title: Chapter 103. The Demon Lord’s Power Source Is Gambling. I Have So Many Questions.
paragraphs: "Let’s put an end to all of this bullshit... I am here to discuss the upcoming apostle gathering scheduled to take place in Aethelgard." Rex said the truth right away.

The throne room stayed still in that moment of tension, with Cassandra’s fist still hanging inches from Rex’s mask and all the demons watching to see what would happen next. Mordecai’s face went from casual interest to serious focus, the kind that made it seem like he was finally taking this situation seriously.
"Alright now, you can let her go," Mordecai said, and even though he didn’t look very strong, his voice was strong.
Rex’s telekinesis let up, and Cassandra took a step back before catching herself. Her face showed shock and anger, as if she had never been so completely beaten before.
She opened her mouth to say something, maybe a threat or a challenge, but Mordecai raised one hand, and she stopped talking right away.
Mordecai leaned forward on his throne and said, "You say you know something about the Apostle gathering."
"That kind of information is so important that you came all the way here to tell me in person... alright, I respect that choice, so I’m listening."
Rex used his foresight to quickly scan the room for any immediate threats or problems. He couldn’t find any, so he started to weave the story he had planned.
"The gathering is in three days." Rex said, "About twenty to twenty-five Apostles from different gods will meet at the Grand Academy in Aethelgard."
"They’re planning a multipronged attack on your demon strongholds, with the goal of destroying the Demon Seed production facilities and crippling your operations on the surface."
Mordecai’s eyes got smaller with suspicion. "How do you... know all of this?"
"Because I’ll be there," Rex said simply. "I can move through shadows without being seen, and I can be anywhere without anyone knowing I’m there."
"I can watch them plan, learn their strategies, and tell you everything in real time if I need to."
Of course, that was a lie. He would be there as Rex Rexilion, the supposed heroic reincarnation who had saved the Starlight family. But Mordecai didn’t need to know that.
"Are you sure you can spy on a group of divine champions without being seen?" Cassandra’s voice was doubtful. "That’s a brave thing to say that... it almost felt like a bland lie."
"I’ve been doing it for months." Rex said, "How do you think I found out about your attack on Aethelgard tonight?"

"I was in their defensive planning meetings, hearing everything... and I knew they were ready for a demon attack, I knew they had Apostles stationed all over the city, and I knew the attack would fail before it even started."
He stopped for a moment to let that sink in. "But I also saw an opportunity."
"The chaos of the battle let me get rid of some troublesome reincarnators and make myself useful to both sides at the same time."
"The surface world thinks I’m one of them, and the underground thinks I’m one of you. But the truth is... I serve neither."
"Then who do you serve?" Mordecai asked, and he sounded very interested.
Rex said, "Myself."
"I am also open to anyone who can assist me in achieving my goals, which is why I am making you this offer." Rex raised both his arms. "You want to weaken the defenses of the surface world."
"I can help you do that well, but I want your resources and the freedom to do what I want."
Mordecai was quiet for a while, which showed that he was really thinking about this. Rex could see the calculation going on behind those eyes as they weighed risks against possible rewards.
"Even though he looks like a midget, he still has some good sense not to trust someone right away.
’That fucking knowledge is clearly coming from his previous life...’
"You mentioned a name," Mordecai said finally. "When you introduced yourself to my maids, what should we call you?"
Rex then thinks for a second, and of course he can’t use his real name. So he just used the rapid answer instead.
"Lustful Villain." Rex said, "That’s the identity I take on when I wear this mask..."
Rex takes a deep breath and gets ready to spill some of his power as the Lustful Villain to raise their trust for the very least.
"My powers come from manipulating people’s desires and lust. I can tell what people want, make their cravings stronger, and use that weakness to control them."

"That’s how I knew Cassandra would attack me as soon as I finished speaking, and that’s how I know you’re more interested in proving yourself as a real ruler than actually taking over the surface world."
Cassandra made an upset noise, but Mordecai raised his hand again to tell her to be quiet. His face had changed to something more like respect and caution.
"A system based on lust... oh wow..." He whispered, "That’s not common at all!"
"Most people who reincarnate get combat or utility systems. You must have done something special to get that blessing."
"You’re probably a pervert bastard, huh?" Mordecai said jokingly with a laugh.
"I am," Rex answered without hesitation.
"Anyway." Rex shrugged and said, "I made an impression on the right goddess."
"Now that I’ve shown you mine, you show me yours..."
"What system are you using, Demon Lord Mordecai? How do you have the power to control so many demons and attack fortified cities at the same time?"

Rex thought for a second that Mordecai might not answer. Keeping his skills a secret would have been the smart thing to do, but either Mordecai was sure enough of his position to be honest, or he just wanted to show off to someone who might like it.
"Gacha," Mordecai said, and there was no doubt that he was proud of it. "My system is called Demon King’s Infinite Gacha."
’Gacha...? Like some gambling shit you found in the arcade or games these days...?’
"Every day, I can summon demon units based on a randomized pull system, and the quality ranges from common foot soldiers to legendary unique entities."
He waved his hand around the throne room. "Most of my troops are SSR or higher-rank summons."
"Cassandra here is one of only three SSS-rank pulls I’ve gotten in two years of using the system," Mordecai smiled. "She’s irreplaceable, so I’m glad you didn’t actually hurt her."
Rex really wanted to know what that information meant. A gacha system helped him understand how Mordecai’s power worked.
He wasn’t getting people to join his army the usual way, like by recruiting or breeding. He was basically pulling random demon units from a lottery system and sending them out to fight.
That was strong and weak at the same time. It was powerful because it meant he could easily make up for losses as long as his gacha pulls were beneficial.
It was limiting because he couldn’t choose what he received, and his best units were irreplaceable.
Rex said, "That’s really impressive," and he meant it.
"How many pulls do you get each day?"
"Ten standard pulls," Mordecai said. "Or I can save up currency to do multi-pulls that guarantee better results."
"That’s how I got Cassandra. I saved for three months and then did a huge fifty-pull that had three SSS-rank summons, which are the highest-ranking characters in the game.
"And the common pulls? What do they give you?"

"Mostly cannon fodder like those Imp variants, lesser demons, and things that are useful for overwhelming defenses through sheer numbers but don’t have much individual power." Mordecai’s face darkened a little. "The attack tonight killed about two thousand common-rank summons."
"They can be replaced, but it’s still painful to lose that many at once."
Rex put all of this information away as something useful he should remember for the future. Mordecai’s power came from a system for managing resources that gave random results.
That meant that his effectiveness depended a lot on luck, and he needed his rare high-quality summons for any serious fighting.
"Alright, that’s it then. Thank you for that information." Rex crossed his arms. "Let’s go back to the main topic."
Rex changed the subject and said, "There’s something else you need to know."
"You should know about one Apostle at the meeting. His name is Apollo Brightsoul."
"Wait a minute..." Mordecai’s face quickly turned dark. "That name... I know that name!"
"He’s an Apostle of Life and a Paladin. He has led three successful raids on demon settlements in the last year."
"He’s more dangerous than you think," Rex said next. "For now I can predict that Apollo has a Harem King system that the Goddess of Life herself blessed."
"He gets stronger the more devoted nine women are to him, and as long as his harem is alive, he can’t be killed. Every time they fight together, they get stronger."

Rex leaned forward a little, and even though his face was covered, it still showed how serious he was. "Apollo and any reincarnators connected to the Goddess of Life are the biggest threats to reincarnators who choose the villain path."
"The Goddess of Life sees us as corruption that needs to be cleaned up. She trains her Apostles to hunt people like us."
"Then we have to get rid of him," Cassandra said right away. "Send our best troops to surprise him at the meeting."
"No," Rex said without any emotion. "That’s exactly what you shouldn’t do."
"Apollo loves to fight directly. He’s a combat expert who gets stronger when he faces impossible odds because it activates his heroic narrative buffs."
"Sending demons after him just gives him experience and makes him stronger. That’s going to be a death wish for you all..."
He put his arms across his chest. "Leave Apollo to me."
"You take care of the other Apostles and the defenses around Aethelgard. Don’t waste your resources on a target that I can take out more easily."

chapters.title: Chapter 104. They Threw a Party for Their Own Downfall. (How Sweet.)
paragraphs: Mordecai looked like he wanted to argue, but he slowly nodded after a moment. "That makes sense..."
"If your lust manipulation system can turn members of his harem against him, that would be better than fighting him directly."
Rex grinned, hidden behind his mask. It was easy to convince Mordecai, which was a little strange but also made sense judging by his whole character.

The demon lord seemed to take explanations at face value and not look for flaws in the reasoning or go deeper. That could have been a sign that they were trying to build trust, or it could have been proof that Mordecai really wasn’t very good at thinking critically.
’It seems like I need to take back about all of my thoughts about him and calculate things...’

Rex was leaning toward the latter based on everything else he’d seen. Mordecai had power from his gacha system, but he didn’t have the strategic cunning or paranoia that someone in his position should have by now.
He acted like a demon lord, treating his role as if it were part of a story, rather than being practical and ruthless, which are necessary qualities in real life.
That made him helpful, expected, and able to be manipulated.
"Now," Rex said, "I’ve given you a lot of information."
"I’ve told you how I can help you, and I think it’s time for you to give me some answers in return."
Mordecai nodded. "Sure, buddy. It seems like we’ve officially become the best of friends with the same way of thinking about this world."
"Being a hero is fun, but it gets boring. So, let’s just be supervillains together!" Mordecai said while standing on his throne and laughing.
’Like hell, I would work with a dumb fraud like you...’
Rex asked. "What was the Demon Seed for? What were you really trying to do?"
Mordecai’s face changed to one that was more serious. He jumped down from his throne and walked down the stairs to a table nearby where a map of the surface world was laid out.
"When I reincarnated as a demon into this world two years ago, I woke up in the Underlayer with no idea how I got there."
"The system turned on right away, giving me the Demon King’s Infinite Gacha and telling me I was now a demon lord in charge of this area."
He pointed to the map. "At first, I thought it was amazing..."
"I had power, an army, and a whole civilization at my command, but then I started to learn about the demon history of this world and how we interact with the world above."
"Let me guess," Rex said. "You knew that demons were treated like monsters no matter what they did."
"They were killed on sight, hunted for fun, and used as training targets for would-be heroes."
"Holy shit! You actually predicted that... You’re a fucking genius!" Mordecai was even more shocked to see Rex could predict anything without having to fail at it.
"That’s exactly right," Mordecai said, and he sounded very angry. "There’s no nuance."
"No thought that some demons might not want to spend their whole lives hiding underground... The surface world has decided we’re evil, and nothing we do changes that."
He pointed to a few places on the map. "I thought the Demon Seed could change that.
"If I could create surface dwellers who possessed demon strength but appeared and behaved like humans, they could serve as bridges."
"They would show the surface world that demon power doesn’t equal demon evil, and they would make a new type of being that both sides could accept."
"But the process of changing them makes them out of control," Rex said. "It changes them into the exact monsters you were trying to show aren’t demons."
"I know that..." Mordecai said, "The formula needs to be improved."
"The current version works for about forty minutes before the subject loses control."
"Some subjects can take multiple doses and stay in control for longer, but even they eventually give in... It’s not working the way I hoped."
"Because you’re going about it the wrong way." Rex said, "You’re trying to force a biological change to keep your mind stable."
"That’s exactly why it could go wrong at anytime! All you need to do is set up the psychological anchor first and then build the change around it."
"W-What..." Mordecai blinked. "You think you can fix it?"
"I have ideas," Rex said slowly.
He didn’t really care about fixing the Demon Seed, but acting like he did made him seem more important. "But that’s a conversation for later, after we’ve gotten to know each other better."
"If you’re an Apostle," he changed the subject. "Which god gave you your system?"
"I actually am an Apostle and they didn’t invite me to that gathering. What kind of bullshit is that!?" Mordecai said, "Goddess of Chaos."
"Eris, to be exact... and she thinks the whole demon lord thing is funny."
"She gave me the gacha system and told me to ’make things interesting on the surface.’ I’ve been doing my best to follow that order."
Rex noted Eris was probably another Forbidden God, one of the gods who worked against the main pantheon led by the Goddess of Life.
That made some of Mordecai’s dislike of surface heroes make sense, but it also meant that he was working under certain divine limits that might make him less useful in the long run.
"Okay," Rex said as he got up. "I think we understand each other even better now."

"I’ll go to the Apostle gathering in three days and bring back their full battle plans." Rex raised his finger. "In return, you give me resources, safe passage through demon territory, and the freedom to do what I want."
"Do we have ourselves a deal?"
"Hell yeah! Let’s fucking go with it." Mordecai looked at him for a long time before reaching out his hand. "You’re in!"
"Lustful villain, welcome to the alliance."

Rex shook his hand, which made the deal official. It was built on lies and manipulation on both sides, but that was fine. He didn’t need this to be a permanent partnership. He just needed it to last long enough to serve his purposes.
He didn’t want this to be a long-term relationship. He only needed it to last long enough to do what he needed it to do.
Mordecai turned to face the whole throne room and spoke loudly so that everyone could hear. "All demons of Castle Nocturna! I have something important to announce!"
All the demons and other beings there stopped talking and looked at him, waiting to hear what their lord had to say.
Mordecai said, "Tonight’s attack on Aethelgard didn’t go as planned," and the crowd murmured in displeasure. "But it wasn’t a total loss!"
"We learned a lot about how they defend themselves, we tested how quickly they could respond, and most importantly, we made a new reliable, strong friend!"
He pointed to Rex. "This is the Lustful Villain, an Apostle of a Forbidden God who lives in the shadows of the surface world."
"He has brought us prisoners, information, and his great power!" Mordecai raised both his arms. "He will work with us to plan future attacks on the surface cities and their so-called fake heroes."
Rex could feel dozens of eyes on him, judging him and looking him over. Some demons seemed impressed, but some demons looked like they didn’t trust him.
Some of them even looked openly hostile, probably because they saw him as a rival for Mordecai’s favor.
Mordecai went on, "The Lustful Villain is the future of our desire to live on the surface," and Rex thought it was funny and a little scary how excited Mordecai’s voice was getting.
"We can still be great without bowing down to false gods and their puppet heroes, and... He is proof of this."

The crowd were getting into it now, cheering and agreeing with what they heard. Mordecai was using Rex as a symbol to get his followers excited after a failed military campaign, just like a political rally.
"We will show no mercy or quarter to these self-righteous Apostles!"
"They will not control our lives!"
"We will rise!"
"We will take what is rightfully ours!"
"And with allies like the Lustful Villain fighting with us, we cannot fail again...!"

The throne room was filled with demons shouting and cheering, and some of them even raised weapons or fists in salute. Rex heard music coming from somewhere, and he knew this was becoming an unplanned party.
He stood there in the middle of it all, his face covered, and felt nothing but cold amusement.
Mordecai thought he had found a friend. The demons thought they had found a hero.
They were celebrating what they thought was their good luck and already thinking about future wins.
They didn’t know they were just tools. Rex was manipulating pieces on a board to achieve goals they were unaware of.
Every bit of trust they gave him was just another way for him to get what he wanted. He could use every secret they told him against them.
There was no alliance here.
Everyone involved was a target, and the entire situation was a scam.
Rex allowed himself a small smile behind his mask.
Let them celebrate.
Let them feel empowered.
It would make the betrayal that much sweeter when it inevitably came.

"Which god gave you your system?"
"I actually am an Apostle and they didn’t invite me to that gathering.
What kind of bullshit is that!?" Mordecai said, "Goddess of Chaos."
"Eris, to be exact... and she thinks the whole demon lord thing is funny."
"She gave me the gacha system and told me to ’make things interesting on the surface.’ I’ve been doing my best to follow that order."
Rex noted Eris was probably another Forbidden God, one of the gods who worked against the main pantheon led by the Goddess of Life.
That made some of Mordecai’s dislike of surface heroes make sense, but it also meant that he was working under certain divine limits that might make him less useful in the long run.
"Okay," Rex said as he got up.
"I think we understand each other even better now."
"I’ll go to the Apostle gathering in three days and bring back their full battle plans." Rex raised his finger.
"In return, you give me resources, safe passage through demon territory, and the freedom to do what I want."
"Do we have ourselves a deal?"
"Hell yeah!
Let’s fucking go with it." Mordecai looked at him for a long time before reaching out his hand.
"You’re in!"
"Lustful villain, welcome to the alliance."
Rex shook his hand, which made the deal official.
It was built on lies and manipulation on both sides, but that was fine.
He didn’t need this to be a permanent partnership.
He just needed it to last long enough to serve his purposes.
He didn’t want this to be a long-term relationship.
He only needed it to last long enough to do what he needed it to do.
Mordecai turned to face the whole throne room and spoke loudly so that everyone could hear.
"All demons of Castle Nocturna!
I have something important to announce!"
All the demons and other beings there stopped talking and looked at him, waiting to hear what their lord had to say.
Mordecai said, "Tonight’s attack on Aethelgard didn’t go as planned," and the crowd murmured in displeasure.
"But it wasn’t a total loss!"
"We learned a lot about how they defend themselves, we tested how quickly they could respond, and most importantly, we made a new reliable, strong friend!"
He pointed to Rex.
"This is the Lustful Villain, an Apostle of a Forbidden God who lives in the shadows of the surface world."
"He has brought us prisoners, information, and his great power!" Mordecai raised both his arms.
"He will work with us to plan future attacks on the surface cities and their so-called fake heroes."
Rex could feel dozens of eyes on him, judging him and looking him over.
Some demons seemed impressed, but some demons looked like they didn’t trust him.
Some of them even looked openly hostile, probably because they saw him as a rival for Mordecai’s favor.
Mordecai went on, "The Lustful Villain is the future of our desire to live on the surface," and Rex thought it was funny and a little scary how excited Mordecai’s voice was getting.
"We can still be great without bowing down to false gods and their puppet heroes, and...
He is proof of this."
The crowd were getting into it now, cheering and agreeing with what they heard.
Mordecai was using Rex as a symbol to get his followers excited after a failed military campaign, just like a political rally.
"We will show no mercy or quarter to these self-righteous Apostles!"
"They will not control our lives!"
"We will rise!"
"We will take what is rightfully ours!"
"And with allies like the Lustful Villain fighting with us, we cannot fail again...!"
The throne room was filled with demons shouting and cheering, and some of them even raised weapons or fists in salute.
Rex heard music coming from somewhere, and he knew this was becoming an unplanned party.
He stood there in the middle of it all, his face covered, and felt nothing but cold amusement.
Mordecai thought he had found a friend.
The demons thought they had found a hero.
They were celebrating what they thought was their good luck and already thinking about future wins.
They didn’t know they were just tools.
Rex was manipulating pieces on a board to achieve goals they were unaware of.
Every bit of trust they gave him was just another way for him to get what he wanted.
He could use every secret they told him against them.
There was no alliance here.
Everyone involved was a target, and the entire situation was a scam.
Rex allowed himself a small smile behind his mask.
Let them celebrate.
Let them feel empowered.
It would make the betrayal that much sweeter when it inevitably came.

chapters.title: Chapter 105. This Lustful Villain Form is Insanely Overpowered! (I Could Take Anything!)
paragraphs: The party that came after was loud and crazy, just like Rex would have expected from a demon party. Long tables appeared out of nowhere, full of food and drink that looked bad but were apparently considered delicacies in demon culture.

Music played at levels that would have been seen as assault with a deadly weapon on the surface. Demons danced, fought, argued, and laughed with a wild energy that came from beings who didn’t care about being polite.
Rex watched everything with a detached interest, taking mental notes on the demon social hierarchy and cultural practices while also keeping his mind on his real goal for the night.
’Full of fucking weirdos...’
’Well, at least they’re happy to be used for me soon.’
’Now... this form, it seems like there are no side effects of anything.’ Rex looked at himself. ’I didn’t feel any negative effects on me, so I guess... this form can really be my second life.’

He hadn’t fully explored the passive effects of his Lustful Villain form yet. Lustia had said that the change would make people around him want him more, making him naturally more attractive and interesting to anyone who was open to lust or desire.
And of course, Rex already had a brilliant idea to try that out in a controlled setting and see how well it works.
Lilith hadn’t left his side since they got to the castle. Even now, she was close to him, with one hand resting on his arm in a casual way that showed she owned him.
Her red eyes kept finding his mask, and every time she looked at him, Rex’s desire level rose through his system interface.
’This succubus... I fucking knew that she was going to be like glued to me.’ Rex smirks.

’Well, at least this could be my energy generator for today, providing me with the energy I need to unlock that Infinite Regeneration ability, which allows me to heal continuously, with the maximum desire bonus from her.’
[LILITH NOCTURNE: 70/100 → 85/100]
[REASON: EXTENDED PROXIMITY TO LUSTFUL VILLAIN FORM, PASSIVE DESIRE AMPLIFICATION, EMOTIONAL BOND STRENGTHENING]

The numbers were going up even though he wasn’t doing anything. Being close to her in this form, letting her soak up the aura of power and desire that came from the Lustful Villain identity, was pushing her to the limit.
’What the fuck...? If I knew I could raise the desire level that high with this form, I might as well use this to the Starlight.’
"But, damn, it could be a little risky... I don’t want to get caught or something.’
’I just need to stick with Rex Rexilion to steal them, and while I use this form if necessary.’
He made the choice to speed things up on purpose. Rex’s full attention was on Lilith, and the way his masked face was angled toward her showed that he was very interested.
He could feel the desire energy in the air and shape it in a way that sent more of it toward Lilith specifically through his energy manipulation.
’Alright, it’s time for this fuckboy to rizz up more girls or women so that I can fuck them~! And it’s going to be my first time to fuck a demon or a succubus.’
Rex said, "You’ve been very helpful tonight, Lilith."
His voice was low and had undertones that his mask made sound almost hypnotic. "You’ve kept your sisters from being suspicious of me, brought me here, and been there for me through everything."
"I value loyalty like that."
Rex saw Lilith’s pupils get bigger even though the throne room was lit by red lights, and he could see heart shapes formed on them again.
"I...! I would do anything for my dark savior," she said, and her voice was full of emotion. "You saved my life..."
"You’re also strong, mysterious, and perfect, and I never want to be away from you again!"
[LILITH NOCTURNE: 85/100 → 95/100]
Direct attention and verbal confirmation. They were very effective, even though they were simple, because they worked with the Lustful Villain form’s passive aura.
Rex reached out and ran one gloved finger along Lilith’s jaw. It was a touch that was both gentle and possessive.
He said, "Then I guess that makes you mine then," not as a question but as a statement.
"My loyal servant..." Rex whispered in her sensitive ear. "...and my devoted servant."
"It’s all mine to command and use however I want."
Those words and that touch made Lilith feel like she was going to melt. Her eyes closed halfway, her breathing sped up, and a shiver ran through her body.
"Y-Y-Yes," she said with her tail tensed up. "I’m yours...! All of yours, and forever yours!"
"I’ll go anywhere you want me to go, do anything you want me to do, and be whatever you need me to be...!"
[LILITH NOCTURNE: 95/100 → 100/100 MAXIMUM]
[ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: DEMON DEVOTION COMPLETE]
[SPECIAL TRAIT UNLOCKED: LILITH NOW HAS PERMANENT TELEPATHIC LINK TO REX]
Rex felt that manipulation was so easy that her desire level was already maximum, and the system knew that Lilith had reached the highest level of devotion.
She was completely his now, bound to him by a desire and obsession so strong that nothing could break it.
It was cool that they could talk to each other telepathically. He would have to look into what that meant later.
But for now, he had other things to test.
"Alright... one down, and I need to put some good tests on the others." Rex patted her head and told Lilith to do anything she wanted other than be with him.

Lilith then left Rex alone to eat a lot of food, while Rex’s eyes were already locked onto Cassandra, who was standing close to Mordecai, the demon queen, and appeared very unhappy about what had happened that night.
She had her arms crossed, her body language was defensive, and she kept looking at Rex with suspicion every few minutes.
’There it is... It was always more fun to crack hard-to-get targets.’
He walked across the throne room to Cassandra. When she saw him coming, her face hardened, as if she were ready for a fight.
"So... are you still upset about what happened earlier?" Rex asked in a casual way. "I didn’t mean to make you feel bad."
"You were just doing your job to protect your lord, and I respect that."
"You made me look weak in front of everyone as the Demon Queen," Cassandra said, her voice tight with anger that she was trying to hide. "And... I won’t forget that easily."
"I made you look like you were going to lose," Rex said. "There’s a difference, you know?"
"You’re strong, probably the strongest demon in this castle besides Mordecai himself, but me...? Hahaha, well, I’m on a whole other level."
"That’s not weakness on your part... but it’s just how things are right now."
He let the Lustful Villain’s passive aura wash over her, and the desire manipulation worked on levels she probably didn’t even know about. "You know what I think?"
"I think you’re upset or angry because you’ve been the strongest person in every room for so long that meeting someone stronger makes you want to fight me and fuck me at the same time..."
"But how unfortunate... you don’t know how to deal with that, do you?" Rex was playing a very dangerous manipulative trick, but he knows what he’s doing.
Cassandra’s eyes got wide, and her red skin turned redder. "That’s not—I don’t—you can’t just—"
"Can’t what?" Rex moved closer on purpose, getting too close for comfort. "Can’t read you like an open book?"
"Or maybe... can’t see through the tough warrior exterior to the desires underneath?" Rex smirks. "You’re a demon, Cassandra."
"Your entire species is built on desire and passion... so try and not pretend you’re immune to them."
[CASSANDRA VEXMOOR: 0/100 → 25/100]
[REASON: DIRECT CHALLENGE TO PRIDE, PSYCHOLOGICAL DOMINANCE DISPLAY, PASSIVE DESIRE AMPLIFICATION, FORCED CONFRONTATION WITH SUPPRESSED ATTRACTION]
’Just that one teasing conversation got me twenty-five points...’
’The Lustful Villain form worked better than I had hoped... it’s so fucking insane.’
Cassandra was strong and proud, so she didn’t want to give in, but even she couldn’t completely resist the combination of direct manipulation and passive aura.
Cassandra said, "I should kill you right here and now for talking to me like that," but her voice didn’t sound sure.
"You could try." Rex said, "Either way, we both know how that would end."

"Or you could accept that I’m not your enemy, that having someone stronger than you doesn’t make you weaker, and that maybe it would be better for everyone if you worked with me instead of against me."
He stepped back to give her room again. "Think about it."
"I’m going to be around more often now, and... we can spend that time getting on each other’s nerves, or we can spend it becoming something more interesting."
"It’s up to you."

chapters.title: Chapter 106. I Convinced Mordecai to Lend Me His Best Maid (I’m Going to Break Her)
paragraphs: He walked away, leaving Cassandra standing there with a look on her face that made it seem like she was going through many different problems at once.
For the next hour, Rex walked around the room and talked to different demons and beings for short periods of time.
The maids who brought him here, especially Nyx, who kept finding reasons to be near him and hinting that she wanted another "demonstration."
Different demons expressed interest in his fighting style. Some demons in charge who wanted to know how he got information.
Every time he talked to someone, he could plant seeds, turn on the passive desire manipulation of his Lustful Villain form, and make himself a permanent part of Castle Nocturna’s social hierarchy.
The results were clear by the time he looked at his system.
[NYX SHADOWMERE: 45/100 → 62/100]
[SERA NIGHTWHISPER: 0/100 → 18/100]
[MIKA SHADOWPAW: 0/100 → 15/100]
[CLARA EMBERMIST: 0/100 → 12/100]
[YUNA VOIDWALKER: 0/100 → 20/100]
[CASSANDRA VEXMOOR: 25/100 → 38/100]
The numbers were going up all over the place slowly but surely because of how long he had been in his new state. This worked better than his usual Rex Rexilion identity ever could.
The Lustful Villain form was made to speed up desire bonds, and it was doing just that.
’Fuck...! At this point I’ll get addicted to just raising their level to its maximum so that I can just execute them at the spot!’
Rex knew that time was passing, though, even though this worked. He had been in the underlayer for a few hours, and soon the surface world would wake up.
If Rex Rexilion wasn’t in his inn room when morning came, people would notice and ask questions that he didn’t want to answer.
He had to go back to Aethelgard soon, so he had to stop what he was doing tonight and come up with a good reason for leaving.
Rex went back to where Lilith was waiting. The succubus maid grabbed his arm right away, clearly happy that he was back.
"Master~!" Lilith said with her tail wiggling.
"I have everything I need for now," Rex said quietly. "Also... I need to come back to the surface before people notice I’m gone and ask me awkward questions."
Lilith’s face dropped right away, and she held on to his arm tighter. "No! You can’t just LEAVE!"
"You just got here, and I didn’t get to spend much time with you, and what if something happens and you don’t come back and I never see you again?"

Her voice was getting louder and louder, and the fact that she was completely devoted to her maxed-out desire level was turning into an obsession. It felt almost like Lily when her desire level maxed out.
’Not this shit again... but still, I’m pleased to have girls and women obsessed like this. They could be used however I want.’
"Don’t go...! Stay here with me, master!"
"You don’t need to go back to the surface because... you belong here with me."
"Please don’t leave me, Master! It’s going to be lonely for me!"
Rex knew this would happen. Lilith had reached the point of maximum desire very quickly, and the emotional intensity that came with it could have been unhealthy.
He had to be very careful with this, or he might make a demon stalker who could get in the way of his plans.
"Lilith," he said, his voice soft but strong. "I have to keep up my cover on the outside."
"If I go missing, the heroes will get suspicious and might look into it."
"That puts both you and me in danger, and you don’t want that, do you?"
"I don’t care about risk!" Lilith said, "I care about you! All I care about is being close to you! And about—"
"Then come with me," Rex said, cutting in. "Can you look like a human when you go back to Aethelgard?"
"I mean, like... can you blend in on the outside so that your presence is also not identified as a demon or succubus?"
Lilith blinked because she wasn’t expecting the question. "Yes, all succubi can look like humans, and it’s one of our basic powers."
"But Lord Mordecai needs—"
"Lord Mordecai can spare one maid for a few days." Rex said, "Especially if that maid is helping me and keeping me in touch with the Underlayer."
"It’s actually a smart move when you think about it... I stay involved in surface society, gathering information, and you stay with me, keeping the link to Mordecai open."
"Everyone wins, right?"
He could see Lilith’s mind working. She was torn between her desire to be close to him and her loyalty to Mordecai.
The desire quickly prevailed, gradually eroding her loyalty to Mordecai.
"I see!" she said. "Yes, that makes perfect sense!"
"We should do that! I’ll ask Lord Mordecai for permission right now!"

She almost dragged Rex across the throne room to where Mordecai was holding court, with demons all around him trying to get his attention. Lilith pushed her way through the crowd with a single-minded purpose.
"Lord!" she screamed. "To keep his cover, the Lustful Villain needs to go back to the surface!"
"I ask for permission to go with him as your court’s liaison!"
Mordecai looked back and forth between Lilith and Rex, his face showing that he was thinking about the request. "You want to go up there with him?"
"It makes sense from a tactical point of view," Rex said smoothly. "I’ll be more effective if I can talk directly to one of your allies that can blend in with the humans."
"Lilith can carry sensitive information, help me out if I need it, and make sure I’m not working completely alone." Rex raised his arms. "It’s smart operational planning, don’t you think?"
Mordecai thought for a moment and then shrugged. "Well, okay."
"Lilith, you’re in charge of helping the Lustful Villain on the surface." Mordecai pointed at her. "Keep me updated on his actions and our joint operations."
"Don’t let those filthy heroes kill you."
"Thank you, my lord!" Lilith was so happy she was shaking. "I promise to be loyal to him and you!"
She took Rex’s hand and started to pull him toward a part of the castle that was less busy. "Come on, Master~!
"I can teleport us right to where you need to go on the surface!"
"Where’s your base?!"
"Do you have a secret room, a lair, or a hideout?!"
"The Silver Rest Inn." Rex said, "Specifically, my room."
"Can you do that?"

"Of course!" Lilith started to weave the complicated teleportation spell that would connect the Underlayer to the surface over a distance of three hundred miles. "Just hold on to me and don’t let go while we move!"
As the spell took effect, Rex held her hand tightly. Demonic magic cut through dimensional barriers, making the world shrink and twist and space fold in on itself.
Even with his improved sense of reality, the feeling was disorienting because it kept changing as they crossed the impossible distance.
Then they were in Rex’s room at the Silver Rest with just a blink, where he had left it hours before. It was just as comfortable as it had been.
The sunlight hadn’t quite started to come through the window yet, so he had picked the perfect time. Maybe one more hour until dawn.

Lilith appeared fully next to him, and as the spell finished, her shape changed. Her demonic features became less pronounced, her skin tone changed from pale blue to a more human peach, and her eyes changed from bright red to a more normal brown.
Her tail and any other obvious demonic traits vanished completely, making her look like a perfectly normal, if stunning, woman.
"There," she said, pointing to herself. "Full human disguise~!"
"No one will know I’m a succubus unless I want them to."
She looked around the room with obvious interest, taking in the bed, the desk, and the simple furniture. "So this is where you’ve been living?"
"It’s nice, cozy, and personal~!"
She turned to face Rex, her gaze filled with a devoted yet clearly hungry look. She walked toward the bed with purpose, her movements smooth and inviting.
When she lay down on the mattress, she did so in a way that made every curve of her body stand out.

"Master," she said, and the way she said it made it sound like a title and a prayer at the same time. "I know you’re tired from everything that happened tonight, but I need to do something before you go to sleep."
She moved around, lying back on the bed and looking up at him with eyes that showed nothing but desire. "Let’s do it... Master..."
"I want to show you how thankful I am for saving me, and I want to show you how devoted I am to you."
"I... want to be yours in every way a succubus can be."
Her hand reached out to him, inviting him, promising him, and giving him everything.
"Let’s do it, Master... as a way to thank you for saving me."

"Buy Infinite Regeneration," he told himself.

[REMAINING BALANCE: 500 POINTS]
[SKILL GAINED]

[REGENERATION SPEED: SCALES WITH SEVERITY (SECONDS FOR MINOR WOUNDS, MINUTES FOR MAJOR WOUNDS, AND UNDER ONE HOUR FOR LOST LIMBS)]
[LIMITATION: PAIN STILL EXPERIENCED DURING REGENERATION PROCESS]

’What the fuck was that limitation...? I thought I’d regenerate everything for only a second, not a whole hour just for losing limbs...’

’And that is...?’
[FULL POTENTIAL ADAPTATION]
Rex’s eyes widened reading that. ’Adaptation... yes... now I fucking get it...’
’Imagine getting hurt by something and then you don’t feel a thing about it... That’s actually genius.’
’Maybe that’s my next skill target, and with that I could probably do anything I want, but fuck... I fucking know it’s going to be expensive as fuck.’
[DO YOU WANT TO KNOW HOW MUCH DESIRE ENERGY YOU NEED?]
’Just hold it for a while... let me enjoy my results for the Infinite Generation.’
[UNDERSTOOD]

The power rushed through him and settled into his cells, like water soaking into sand. He could feel it right away: a low-level hum of regenerative energy that would turn on by itself whenever he got hurt.
Little cuts healed in seconds. In just a few minutes, broken bones mended themselves. Even lost arms and legs could regrow if given enough time.

He had finally learned one of the most important skills that would make it impossible to kill him. With his Foresight letting him see attacks coming and his Telekinesis letting him defend or avoid them, he was becoming truly dangerous in ways that most opponents wouldn’t be able to stop.
Rex couldn’t help it. At first, he laughed quietly, but as he realized how happy he was to have reached this milestone, his laughter grew louder.
He had been working toward this moment from the start, building up energy through careful manipulation and strategic bonding, and now he had it.
"Hehehehe... HAHAHAHAHA!" The laugh was real and free, the kind that comes from reaching a goal you had been working hard to reach.
Lilith woke up when she heard the noise. She moved around and mumbled in her sleep, but then she opened her eyes and looked at him.
She stared for a moment, still mostly asleep. Then she seemed to realize that he was laughing and thought that meant she should laugh too.
Lilith giggled, "Ehehehe..." Her voice was still thick with sleep.
"Master’s happy... and that makes me happy too... ehehe..."

The light from the early morning sun was just starting to come through the window, painting the room in gray tones that would soon give way to the full brightness of dawn.
’Having sex with a succubus really drains all my stamina fast...’

I have to find another new woman for me to get that one thousand desire energy so that I can focus on getting stronger and stronger...’

It made a few little, rhythmic noises that made it sound like she was fast asleep and pleased with how the night had ended.
’I thought all she could do was just talk, but it seems like her skill really was expert.’
’As expected from a succubus... they’re created to fulfill a man’s fantasy.’
’Now, regarding my situation, my eyes are burning intensely, and I desire to be close to you for an entire day.’

paragraphs: She sat up and rubbed her eyes. For the first time since waking up, she was able to focus on Rex.
And then what she realized right away was that Rex wasn’t wearing any mask to cover up his true identity, which made her eyes widen with surprise.
"A-Ahh...! M-Master," she said, and her voice sounded almost reverent. "I can... FINALLY see your real face..."

Rex forgot that the only time she’d ever seen him was when he was wearing the Lustful Villain mask. Lilith was seeing Rex Rexilion’s real face for the first time, and based on the look on her face, she liked this version even more than the one with the mask.
’Oh, fuck... I didn’t know she would wake up... well, it’s because of the stupid laugh I can’t hold...’
[LILITH NOCTURNE: DESIRE LEVEL CANNOT EXCEED MAXIMUM - OBSESSION INTENSIFYING]
Lilith said, "You’re even more handsome and perfect than I thought," and then she lunged at him with supernatural speed, arms outstretched for a hug.
"This is the first time I fell in love with such a strong, handsome human man~!"

Rex’s telekinesis kicked in without him even thinking about it, stopping Lilith in midair and holding her about three feet away from him. She waved her arms and legs around like a cat trying to swim through the air and made sounds of frustration.
"Noooooo~! Master!"
"Please let me hug you! I need to hug you!"
"I need to be close to you! Your real face is so perfect, and I need to touch it and remember every detail and maybe lick it a little and—"
"No," Rex said firmly, holding her up. "You need to calm down first."
"This obsession is getting out of hand, and I hate it if you went overboard like that..."
"I’m not being overboard...! I’m calm!" Lilith said, "This is me being calm!"
"This is my calm face!" But her face was anything but calm.
Her eyes were full of hearts again, and she was shaking with need. "Hehehe... just let me lick that face... I bet it tastes like chocolateeee~!"
Rex let out a sigh. "Bloody hell..."
He knew this was the highest level of desire, but dealing with it first thing in the morning was testing his patience. He had to find a way to get her energy into something useful.
He said, "Lilith," in a voice that sounded like it was in charge.
"I need you to do something important for me."
"Yes, my Master~!" She stopped flailing right away and focused all of her attention on him. "Anything!"
"What do you want?"
"I need you to attack me," Rex said. "Use any demonic power you have.
"I want you to hurt me as much as you can without killing me."
Lilith’s face changed many times in a short amount of time. "Heh...?"
She was confused, worried, and then realized that this must be some kind of test. "Are you sure, Master? I don’t want to hurt my master..."
"In fact, Master can just hurt me right now, even though I don’t have any masochistic kink~!"
"I’m trying out a new skill." Rex said, "And yes, I’m sure, as long as you can hurt me but other than kill me."
"I need to see how well it works and what its limits are." Rex stretches out both arms. "Go ahead and give it your best shot."
He let go of her telekinetic grip, and she fell to the ground in a crouch. As she got ready to attack, her demonic features became more obvious.
"O-Okay..." Her claws grew longer, and her eyes glowed with internal fire.
She said, "If Master commands it," and there was real regret in her voice even as she gathered her strength.
Her clawed hand came in toward his left arm with the speed of a demon. Rex could have easily dodged with his Foresight, but he chose to stay still and let the attack hit him.
The claws scraped across his forearm with enough force to cut through skin, muscle, and bone. His arm came off his body just below the elbow and fell to the floor with a wet thud.

The pain came on quickly and was so bad that it made Rex’s vision blurry for a moment. He bit his teeth together to keep from screaming and made himself pay attention to what he was feeling instead of reacting.
And then the Infinite Regeneration started to work.
He could feel the supernatural healing energy flooding the site of the injury. As new tissue grew, the stump of his arm began to glow with a faint golden light.

The bone comes first, growing out from the cut point like a plant in time-lapse. Then muscle wrapped around it in layers. Then blood vessels, nerves, and skin all rebuilt themselves at an impossible speed.
In less than thirty seconds, his arm was back to normal. He tried out his new fingers by bending them and moving them around.
Everything went perfectly, as if the injury had never happened.
"W-What the fuck...?" Rex said, "It works just for a few seconds," more to himself than to Lilith.
"Full regeneration of a lost limb in less than a minute...!"
Rex gritted his teeth in frustration, realizing that the system had provided unreliable information. ’Okay, explain to me why this works faster?!’
[FORGOT TO TELL YOU THAT REGENERATING ONE WOUND LIKE THAT COULD END UP FAST]
[AND NOW... IMAGINE YOURSELF IN A SCENARIO WHERE YOU LOST MORE THAN FIVE LIMBS]
Rex then gets what the system meant. ’Ahh... that’s why I needed that fucking adaptation, huh.’
"Great... and it seems like an immortality skill could work too.’
[YOU’LL BECOME THE UNKILLABLE IMMORTAL LUSTFUL VILLAIN WITH THAT]
[AND YOU BETTER START GRINDING IF YOU WANT IMMORTALITY AND ADAPTATION]
’So it’s decided then. I know what I want next.’
Lilith’s tail tensed up. "A human has a powerful regeneration skill...!?"

"Yeah, but the pain was real... and it felt very bad and made it hard to do things." Rex said this aloud and then reflected on it internally. ’That was also the limit that the system had warned about.’
He could come back from anything that didn’t kill him right away, but it would hurt every second. And he can still die if the system just mentioned the immortality skill.
’Still... nevertheless... it’s all worth it.’
’Pain was temporary and manageable, but it was very useful to be able to heal from injuries that would kill or cripple normal people.’
"Master!" Lilith was right next to him, her hands hovering over where his arm had been cut off, her eyes wide with fear and guilt. "I’m so sorry...!"
"I hurt you, didn’t I!? I’m an awful servant!" Lilith showed her butt. "I should be punished! Please punish me for hurting Master!"
And then she changed her mind by wrapping her arms around him and putting her face against his chest. "I’ll make it better!"
"I’ll spoil you, and I’ll do anything to make up for hurting you!"
She tilted her head back and moved her lips toward his mouth, which was clearly meant to be an apology kiss.
"No, no, don’t need that right now—"
The door to Rex’s room flew open.
Both Rex and Lilith froze, and their heads snapped toward the door.
The one who opened the door was Lily, with an innocent-looking face as always.
And now she stood in the doorway, her hand still on the doorknob, and then her face was shocked and quickly turned into rage.
Her eyes took in the scene: Rex was sitting on the bed with a demon woman with blue skin and horns pressed against him. Their faces were only inches apart, as if they were about to kiss.
The frame shook when the door slammed shut.
It then opened right away, showing Lily with both hands surrounded by crackling magical energy. Her face had gone from shocked and hurt to angry and protective.
"GET AWAY FROM HIM!" Lily screamed, raising one hand to cast a spell at Lilith. "YOU DISGUSTING DEMON!"
"I DON’T KNOW HOW YOU GOT IN HERE OR WHAT YOU’RE DOING TO REX BUT I’LL—"

chapters.title: Chapter 113. Five Seconds of Peace Before They Fought Over Who Makes My Breakfast
paragraphs: "STOP!" Rex’s command was so forceful that it brought both women to a halt.
His telekinesis struck at the same time, grabbing Lily’s raised hand and stopping the spell from being cast while also putting a barrier between her and Lilith.
As Lily fought against the unseen force holding her arm, the magical energy faded away. "Rex! That’s a demon! And what’s worse is that she’s a succubus!"
"She’s dangerous, and we need to—"
"I know what she is." Rex said in a calm but firm voice, "She’s not a threat, so back off, Lily."
Lily looked at him like he had a second head. "What do you mean back off...?!"

"She’s a DEMON! They attack us! They tried to destroy the capital! And you’re just sitting there with one wrapped around you like—like—" Her voice cracked a little, and he could tell that she was really upset.
"What’s going on?"
Rex let out a sigh. This was going to need careful planning.

Both women were at their highest levels of desire, which meant that their emotional reactions would be strong and maybe even crazy. He had to calm things down before they got out of hand and drew too much attention in the inn or even destroyed it by accident.

"Both of you, sit down for a minute," he said, exerting the perfect amount of telekinetic force to propel them toward the two chairs by his desk. "Just time out and take a deep breath to hear my explanation."
Lilith did what she was told right away, almost bouncing into one of the chairs with eagerness. Lily fought it for a moment, but then she moved to the other chair.
She never took her eyes off the demon woman, whom she clearly didn’t trust or like. "Look at her... it’s disgusting."
"You racist piece of shit!" Lilith was about to attack her, but then she managed to control herself.
They sat next to each other, both looking at him, waiting for an explanation that would make sense of this.
Rex stood up and faced them, putting his thoughts together in a way that would please both of them without giving away too much. "Alright now... where to start..."
"Lily, this is Lilith..."
"Yes, she’s a demon, but she’s not our enemy."
"She’s working with me to get information from inside the demon strongholds and tell me what they’re up to."
"You’re working with a... demon," Lily said flatly, and her voice made it clear how crazy she thought that sounded. "That shouldn’t be possible... they can’t trust any humans, and neither can we!"
Rex corrected, "I’m working with someone who can give me useful information about how demons work."
"Information that could save lives and help protect Aethelgard."
"Would you rather we go to the Apostle gathering without knowing what the demons are up to or with knowledge of what they are planning?"

Lily’s face changed a little, and she was torn between doubt and the logic of what he was saying. Her highest level of desire was working in his favor, making her want to believe him and trust his judgment even when it didn’t seem right.
"And you," Rex said, looking at Lilith. "You will not threaten Lily or hurt her, and you will treat her with respect."
"Do you understand that?"
"Yes, Master!" Lilith said right away. "She’s important to you, so she’s important to me as well!"
"I’ll do anything to keep her safe, and I can also be her first demon friend!"

"I’m working for Master ONLY." Lilith said, "I do whatever he needs me to do."
"Even if that means helping humans, then I’ll do it. If that means betraying other demons, then I will." Lilith bowed down to Rex. "I exist to serve him."
It was clear from the way she spoke that she was completely devoted. Lily heard it and knew what it was, and her face changed.
It was not quite acceptance, but recognition of a pattern that is familiar. "This feels kind of familiar..."
’Oh shit... does she notice...?’
"She’s like me," Lily said quietly as she looked at Rex. "Isn’t she?"
"That kind of devotion... and that single-minded focus. You’ve done to her what you did to me."
"Yeah." Rex looked her in the eye. "She’s completely bound to me, just like you are."
"So you don’t have to worry about her being a threat. She can’t hurt me or anyone I care about without going against her main purpose."
Lily was quiet for a long time while she thought about this. Her highest level of desire was pushing her to accept and trust Rex’s judgment, but he could see that she was having a difficult time.
There was real jealousy and possessiveness, and seeing another woman tied to Rex in the same way she was made her feel all kinds of complicated things.
’Ah yeah... there it is... she doesn’t care if it’s a demon or anything. That’s just her usual jealousy shit.’
Lily asked, "I’m not going to be replaced, am I?" Her voice was so small that it made her sound younger than her twenty years.
"What? Of course not!" Rex said with conviction. "Never.
He crossed over to her, knelt down so they were at eye level, and took her hands in his. "You were the first..."
"You’re special, and nothing will ever change that."
"Lilith has a purpose and gives me important information I need, but you are irreplaceable to me."
"Mara’s the first, though..." Lily looked away with a shy look.
"You’re my first virgin... still counts." Rex didn’t believe she still bites back with that word.
Lily’s eyes searched his face for any signs that he was lying. She slowly nodded when she couldn’t find any.
"Okay... I believe you."
She turned to look at Lilith. Her face was still wary, but it was no longer openly hostile.
"I guess I’ll try to trust you too, but if you hurt him—"
"I would kill myself before I hurt Master." Lilith said right away, "Anyway~! We can be good friends!"
"Our name almost has the same tone~! We can both serve him! It’ll be fun, right?!"
"Fun," Lily said again, her tone making it clear that she didn’t believe what she had just said, but she didn’t say anything else, which Rex saw as a win.
"Of course..." Lily nodded with a smile. "I’m sorry to act harsh with you, Lilith."
"It’s alright~!"
Of course, the moment of peace only lasted about five seconds.
Lilith and Lily both quickly turned to look at each other, then at Rex, and then back at each other. It looked like they were talking to each other without saying anything, and then they both moved.
"Master needs breakfast!" Lilith shouted as she jumped up. "I’ll cook him the best breakfast ever! Demon-style food that will—"
"He’s not eating demon food." Lily stood up and said, "I know what he likes!"
"I’ll make him breakfast and—"
"I can take better care of him!" Lilith said. "I’m a professional attendant! I’ve been trained in—"
"I know him better!" Lily said, "I know what he likes and—"

Now they were both talking over each other, their voices getting louder as they each tried to prove that they were the main caregiver. In a matter of seconds, they were standing face to face, glaring at each other with clear competitive tension.
"THAT’S ENOUGH!" Rex’s voice cracked like a whip, and it had just enough real anger in it to end their fight right away.
